hook: → 观点卡：AI Agent 软件工程生产力与安全风险
lines: The guest notes that AI-native software engineering tools like Cognition's Devon have scaled rapidly, with some firms doubling their pull request throughput and experiencing up to 10x output gains.

The host and guest discuss how autonomous agent swarms introduce urgent cybersecurity risks that make major institutional breaches statistically inevitable, while simultaneously providing defensive capabilities through automated monitoring.

The guest argues that the current high cost of infrastructure is fully justified by the value generated by AI tokens, indicating that compute scarcity is a temporary supply-chain challenge rather than a flaw in the business model.

The discussion highlights the transition of software engineers from manual coding to high-level architectural oversight, as multi-agent systems increasingly manage complex, multi-step development lifecycles.
podcast: Invest Like the Best with Patrick O'Shaughnessy
title: Scott Wu on Cybersecurity, Compute, and the Future of Engineering - [Invest Like the Best, EP.502]
